headline: Palantine Berm Swaps Hands Rapidly as Northern Fronts Erupt
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, combat has flared anew across Marban Hollow and the Nevish Line, where shifting control of Checkpoint Bua and Grief Mother accompanied fresh base exchanges in the morning hours. Palantine Berm remains the war's fiercest flashpoint, suffering ten strategic base overturns within the last two hours alone as fighting centers on Vendett and the Pippeli Stones, even as localized casualty rates temper. Weathered Expanse saw renewed base upheaval right up to the telegraph deadline, absorbing over eleven hundred casualties in two hours alongside turnovers at Spirit Watch and Wightwalk. In Linn of Mercy, strategic base positions held steady over the past two hours, yet the slaughter continues unabated with over seventeen hundred casualties logged in that brief span. Gutter has settled into an uneasy pause following its earlier turnover of Suojus, while combat in Stlican Shelf cools markedly from previous heights. Mooring County and the deep southern sectors show no further movement, leaving the central and northern salients to bear the brunt of the offensive storm.
